name: Insulting People
overview: Scripture warns believers against insulting others, teaching that angry words and name-calling like 'Raca' or 'fool' bring serious spiritual consequences, including judgment and even hellfire. While followers of Christ may face false accusations and revilement for His sake, they are called to avoid filthiness, foolish talk, and inappropriate jesting, choosing instead to give thanks. The warnings emphasize the power of words to harm, comparing malicious speech to the destructive nature of firebrands, and encourage believers to exercise restraint and holiness in their communication.
